title: Shared tag direction and degree-24 cyclotomic packing
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5561 MiB (5.4305 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 22513 million field multiplications (14518 and 7995), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
